newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Caracas stocks end flat, readying for new rises.
newsitem.headline: Caracas stocks end flat, readying for new rises.

text.p: Caracas stocks closed broadly flat in strong trade as the market digested recent rises and readied itself for further gains, brokers said.
"The market was very animated, which indicates an end to the correction that many thought would be much deeper," Multinvest broker Jose Gregorio Tineo said.
Approval late Tuesday of the crucial Labor Law reform bill, plus the prospect of strong company results, augured well for the market, Tineo said. "We're on the eve of strong growth."

The bolsa's 19-share index closed at 7,256.51 points as among traded issues 18 rose, 15 fell and eight closed flat. Trade volume was boosted to 281 million shares, worth 8.6 billion bolivars ($17.7 million) as over 200 million Corimon B shares exchanged hands. The stock ended up 8.63 percent at 17.00 bolivars.
"There's a lot of expectation of good company results," Westsphere brokerage executive director Enrique Lerner said.
Corimon stockholders are also due to consider July 21 a proposal to advance the conversion of the company's preferred B shares into common A shares, which has boosted the share price, Lerner added.
Merinvest's composite index, which includes telephone company CANTV, also closed flat at 114.69 points.
